what_was_done: AudioSet (AST) classifier run on the real 15s soundtrack: speech dominant in all 5 windows
faster-whisper transcribed the real voice track: Urdu, p=1.0, 4 segments, no_speech_prob 0.005
stem-level RMS comparison proving the voice >= 10.5 dB above music in all 15 windows
no silent gaps in any 1s window
what_was_NOT_done: no human listened to the mix
no judgment of musicality, warmth, or whether the drone is the right drone
honest_position: A machine can prove the voice is louder than the music. It cannot prove the soundtrack is good. This gate is therefore satisfied on measurement and explicitly fails to satisfy the artistic half.
